services.name: fleet-api
services.role: core FastAPI service exposing REST API and telemetry ingestion
services.reason: Defined in docker-compose.yml as main service with ports 8000 and healthcheck

services.name: toxiproxy
services.role: chaos proxy for fleet-api ingestion path
services.reason: Added in docker-compose.chaos.yml to proxy loadgen traffic

services.name: fleet-simulator
services.reason: Defined in docker-compose.yml with profile demo and depends_on fleet-api

services.name: loadgen
services.role: external telemetry load generator used in chaos tests
services.reason: Appears in known chaos links as source of telemetry ingestion

services.name: sqlite-db
services.role: embedded SQLite database storing fleet data
services.reason: DB_DB_URL environment variable points to sqlite:///data/fleet.db

data_flows.name: telemetry_ingest
data_flows.description: External load generator sends telemetry through toxiproxy to fleet-api which stores it in SQLite

data_flows.name: simulation_flow
data_flows.description: Simulator posts telemetry directly to fleet-api which persists it
